findings.summary: The SFC, AFRC and the Exchange issued a joint statement setting supervisory expectations for listed issuers with audit disclaimers solely relating to going concern. It expects robust assessments supported by reasonable assumptions, reliable data and feasible action plans, alongside detailed annual and quarterly progress disclosures and critical audit-committee and auditor review. The statement does not amend Listing Rules or set a new deadline; the Exchange may consider rule changes if improvement is not significant.
findings.title: SFC, AFRC and the Exchange join forces to address disclaimers of opinion solely relating to going concern

rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 9 October 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 The SFC, AFRC and the Exchange have set out supervisory expectations for listed issuers with audit disclaimers solely relating to going concern. The statement does not amend Listing Rules or set a new deadline, but may affect listed banking-group issuers and investment or credit teams assessing affected counterparties through disclosure quality, valuation and investor-protection considerations. Hong Kong 🟡 SFC, AFRC and the Exchange join forces to address disclaimers of opinion solely relating to going concern 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20261008-sfc-web-050ffd939c ⏰ Deadline: No source deadline stated Products: Investments, listed-issuer exposure The SFC, AFRC and the Exchange have issued a joint statement on listed issuers whose audit disclaimer relates solely to going concern. It expects issuer management to use reasonable assumptions, reliable data and feasible action plans in going-concern assessments, with detailed annual and quarterly disclosure of implementation, progress, deviations and revisions. It also expects audit committees and auditors to critically challenge or evaluate the assessment and the sufficiency of disclosures. This is a supervisory expectation for listed issuers, management, audit committees and auditors—not a new general banking obligation; it does not amend Listing Rules or set a new deadline, although the Exchange may consider rule changes if improvement is not significant. Listed banking-group issuers and investment or credit teams with exposure to affected issuers may be affected through disclosure-quality, valuation, counterparty and investor-protection considerations. Source: SFC, AFRC and the Exchange join forces to address disclaimers of opinion solely relating to going concern Primary source: official document Mainland/GBA No qualifying Mainland/GBA developments were included in this edition. SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. No qualifying benchmark developments were included in this edition. Watch List • Monitor Exchange communications for any proposed Listing Rule change concerning persistent going-concern-only audit disclaimers; no rule amendment is announced in the joint statement.
